news.t1: Preventing Duplicate Requests for the Same Service
news.d1: Now you cannot request the same service twice at the same time. For example, if you already have an ongoing plumbing request, it must be completed before you can submit another plumbing request. However, you can still request other services like cleaning or electrical work.
news.d2: We’ve added a feature to clarify the areas where we can serve you. If your location is too far from the available technicians, you won’t be able to complete the request. This helps us provide you with faster and more accurate service.
news.d3: When canceling any request, you must specify the reason. And if a technician has already accepted your request, a small penalty will be applied due to the late cancellation.
